what: B6 mpmath precision-controlled Evans control solver: three-case test (pilot / Re~0.05 candidate / negative control) + region grids
construction: raw det of M_match=[Qi_Y|Qi_dY|Qe_Y|Qe_dY] (6x6), analytic bases, Frobenius interior seed, exterior incoming = 3 smallest Re(mu) at r_seed with shifted inverse-iteration refinement, RK4 propagation in mpmath, no QR inside the function (holomorphic by construction); column-normalized sigma_min (smin_reg) as scale-invariant zero indicator
verification: product(svals) == |det M| to 15+ digits (mp.eig of M^H M)
RK4 step-doubling: sigma_min drift ~15% per refine x2 (dps 50/80)
r_match 28..35: sigma_min varies 3.2e-9..5.0e-8 (no cancellation at fixed r)
incoming-mu selection continuous across pilot region (rotating branches tracked, no swap)
Frobenius-dominance bound: log_scale_int valid (<~e20 headroom) for t<=~0.3 along diagonal

case_pilot.verdict: NO zero: no |E(omega_0+delta)| ~ |delta| scaling; 5x5 region grid (Re 0.15-0.35, Im 0.03-0.23) shows monotone decay toward (0.35,0.23), minimum 1.5e-11 at corner, no local dip at the pilot

case_candidate_Re005.verdict: NOT a zero: no dip, non-monotone noise-level behavior; indistinguishable from negative control; dps-independent 30/50/80

case_negative.verdict: clean: same level as candidate region (1e-5..1e-6), no dip -> control does what it must

caveat_large_t: beyond t~0.3 along the diagonal the interior Frobenius seed collapses to a rank-1-dominated basis (log_scale_int 7 -> 186; sigma_3 also falls, two zero svals at t=1.0) — the continuing decay there is a construction artifact, NOT evidence of zeros
conclusion: Under the precision-controlled, holomorphic-by-construction Evans test NONE of the three regions shows an isolated zero: the certified pilot at 0.22643+0.08455i is not a zero of E (it sits on a smooth downhill), and the five Re~0.05 gate candidates are noise. The earlier machine-precision 'confirmation' of the pilot was a resolution illusion: high precision moves THROUGH 3e-9 smoothly instead of stopping at a pole.
open: where (if anywhere) E actually vanishes inside the validity region remains open; Gate recalibration and possibly a zero-free certificate (argument principle on the raw holomorphic det with phase tracking) are the next steps
